title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study D)
description: Study D of the bigP3BCI collection, comprising EEG recordings from 17 healthy participants using a P300-based speller with a 6x6 character grid and a dynamic row-column stimulus paradigm. Data were recorded at 256 Hz from 32 channels with a g.USBamp amplifier. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags, and the data are formatted in BIDS via MOABB for machine-learning-ready P300 BCI research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 channels (standard 10-20 montage) with a g.tec g.USBamp at 256 Hz in a laboratory setting. Participants used a visual P300 speller with a 6x6 grid under a calibration-then-test protocol with online feedback. Events were labeled Target or NonTarget with a 0-1.0 s trial interval.
